Integrate validated LLM enrichment into the silver pipeline. Requirement traceability: FR-13; NFR-01, NFR-03, NFR-09. Deliver this bounded increment for the unified lead and communication pipeline. Source of truth: docs/software_requirements.md, docs/project_proposal.md, docs/architecture.md and cited wireframes. Reuse completed scaffold/design work; implement only the missing behavior described below.

## Scope of Work
- [ ] Implement the evaluated provider adapter and structured schema for status, next action/date and urgency using synthetic conversation text.
- [ ] Persist extraction results with raw reference, model/prompt version and processing status before dbt consumes them.
- [ ] Enforce allowed enums/date validation, bounded retries/cost limits, cached replay and prompt/data separation.
- [ ] Route invalid/ambiguous/provider-failed records through documented unknown/baseline handling; preserve approved manual corrections if enabled.

## Technical Considerations
Provider/quality threshold are selected in the spike, not invented here. Extend dbt inputs rather than allowing the LLM to write arbitrary SQL or invoke tools. No client conversations are used during development.

Development data policy: user confirmed all Gmail/Facebook/Viber/AWS/LLM credentials are not ready. Use team-controlled permitted test assets and synthetic conversations; no client data required. Distinguish real API access with synthetic content from mocks and production access.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Real model outputs pass the agreed synthetic evaluation threshold and feed traceable lead fields.
- Invalid outputs never publish unsupported statuses/dates; timeout/replay does not repeatedly bill or duplicate extraction without an explicit retry.
- LLM outage leaves the baseline dashboard usable and visibly degraded; rule-based-only output does not count as FR-13 completion.

## Dependencies
- SNX-24 — Spike: select and evaluate structured LLM extraction
- SNX-29 — Build dbt silver leads and interactions with baseline status parsing
